# [In preview] Public Preview: Prepared Image Specification

## What Changed

Organizations running large-scale, AI, GPU, Windows, and other performance-sensitive workloads on AKS often experience longer node startup times because new nodes must repeatedly download container images and perform initialization tasks before workloads

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A preview can inform roadmap and technical validation, but is not a production commitment.
